results.description:
Think you know music? Prove it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
Soundle is the ultimate music quiz game. Listen to a song clip, pick the right answer, and see how you stack up against friends and players worldwide.                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
How it works                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
Pick from hundreds of playlists spanning every genre, era, and artist. A song clip plays — guess the track, the artist, or both. Answer faster for more points.                                                                                                                                                  

Play your way
- Solo — Play at your own pace and chase high scores
- Challenge a friend — Send a head-to-head challenge and settle who really knows their music
- Random opponent — Get matched with another player for a surprise showdown

Compete and climb
Every playlist has its own leaderboard. Filter by week, month, or all time. Toggle to see only your friends. The top spot is always up for grabs.

Earn achievements
Unlock badges for milestones like total games played, correct answers, perfect rounds, and challenge wins. Track your progress across every category.

Track your stats
Your profile shows your level, XP, accuracy, win rate, and full game history for both solo and challenge modes.

Level up
Earn XP with every game. Rise through the ranks from Newcomer all the way to Hall of Fame across 50 levels.
